next_step: Finalize POC scope, sign NDA, return security questionnaire
notes: Profile: mid-stage CCaaS vendor focused on frontline agent coaching + QA automation. Operates managed voice + multi-channel routing. Want to reduce QA headcount, speed up coaching cycles.
Primary ask: automated post-call summaries + coaching highlights delivered to coach dashboard and CRM ticket; parallel QA scoring for 10k monthly calls.
Traffic profile: 120-220 concurrent calls during peaks; spikes 3x during promos. Must survive holiday/weekend surge. Interested in burst & fallback policies.

Latency target: summary + QA score available within 5s after call end for short-form highlights; full transcript + structured actions within 60s. Throughput target: 200 concurrent summaries/minute at peak.
Cost sensitivity: wants predictable unit pricing; strong interest in Redwood Dedicated or hybrid (dedicated baseline + hosted overflow).
Model preference: open to gpt-style large models for summaries but wants ability to route lower-cost quantized variants for bulk transcripts. Fallbacks to smaller models with preserved QA thresholds.

Security: SOC2 required, SSO/SAML for console, KMS integration for keys, retention controls for transcripts, optional regional residency for EU clients. Will need encryption-in-transit and at-rest and audit logs for all calls.

Tooling: tool-calling automation needed (CRM updates + ticket creation). Expect function-calling/structured outputs (JSON actions) to push into their Salesforce instance. Also want deterministic templates for coaching highlights to feed training pipelines.

Quote from CTO (call 2026-02-10): "We need coaching highlights surfaced to managers within seconds so they can run huddles; if summaries are slow they lose context. Also, show me cost tradeoffs clearly."

POC ask: 4-week POC ingesting live stream + live transcripts -> Redwood Dedicated; deliver 1) short coaching highlights, 2) QA rubrics auto-score, 3) ticket creation payloads. Success metrics: F1 vs human QA >0.82, median summary latency <7s, cost <= $0.06/min token-equivalent for bulk processing.
